templates.title: Homedex
templates.name: homedex
templates.description: Homedex 0.2.5 is a read-only homelab inventory of services, ports, routes, and certificate expiry.

env.name: HOMEDEX_LISTEN
env.label: HOMEDEX_LISTEN
env.description: Address and port Homedex listens on inside the container.

env.name: HOMEDEX_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.label: HOMEDEX_ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.description: Admin password stored as an Argon2id hash on first start. Homedex 0.2.5 exits while this is shorter than 12 characters, so replace CHANGE_ME before the first start. Ignored after an admin exists.

env.name: CONTAINERS
env.label: CONTAINERS
env.description: Allow the socket proxy to read Docker containers.

env.name: IMAGES
env.label: IMAGES
env.description: Allow the socket proxy to read Docker images.

env.name: INFO
env.label: INFO
env.description: Allow the socket proxy to read Docker info.

env.name: NETWORKS
env.label: NETWORKS
env.description: Allow the socket proxy to read Docker networks.

env.name: VERSION
env.label: VERSION
env.description: Allow the socket proxy to read the Docker version.

env.name: POST
env.label: POST
env.description: Disable mutating Docker API calls on the socket proxy.

env.name: ALLOW_START
env.label: ALLOW_START
env.description: Deny container start through the socket proxy.

env.name: ALLOW_STOP
env.label: ALLOW_STOP
env.description: Deny container stop through the socket proxy.

env.name: ALLOW_RESTARTS
env.label: ALLOW_RESTARTS
env.description: Deny container restart through the socket proxy.
